Be careful of getting scam by the cashier.
Nov 2024 • Solo
I was at the store Nov. 2, 2024. Picked out 3 items on the tray. The cashier ask me in broken English it is for take away. I told her yes.

She cashed me out. I paid. I didn’t look at the receipt. When I got back to my hotel, i have 4 items. I looked at the receipt and saw the last time on the receipt was charge which I didn’t ask for and nor did the cashier ask me. 

i was planning to return and try other items but now, never.
